instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for passport renewal requirements and save them in a text file named passport_renewal_requirements.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for passport renewal requirements.
Open an official government website containing passport renewal information.
Type or copy the requirements into the document.
Save the file as passport_renewal_requirements.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
